result_text:
I changed `listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` so it skips stock rows with quantity 0. The query now has `AND s.quantity > 0`, the same filter the other stock overviews use. The stock list for WH-1 will show only "Bolt 10". The single-product quantity lookup is untouched, so nuts still answer 0.

I ran `StockTest`, `StockOverviewTest`, `StockPerCategoryTest` and `LowStockTest` offline and they passed. I did not add a test for the new behaviour, and I did not run the full suite. Nothing is committed.
